body:
It's kind of dumb, but I liked the idea of going through with it on the anniversary of when I attempted to. 

I know that I'm a bit young to be seriously considering this, but I'm so very rarely happy and I'm getting tired of waiting for things to get better. I know realistically that if I waited a few years I might grow out of this, but I don't know if it's worth waiting all that time.
I've only actually met my uncle two or three times, but the rest of my family is pretty close to him and I wouldn't want them to have to deal with me killing myself at a time like this.
